pares.citacao: 'UHPC is known for its high compressive strength of more than 150 MPa with low water/cement ratio [11]' (p.2); M3Q/M2Q tirados de Schmidt et al. [14]

pares.citacao: 'The compressive strength and splitting tensile strength after 28 days and compressive strength after 90 days, were determined following the standard procedures for concrete defined in CSN EN 12390-3 standard [25]' (p.6); 'cast and stored in plastic cubic or cylindrical molds' (p.4)

pares.citacao: 'The ASTM C109/C109M-20a test method [47] was used to examine the Rc differences between printed and mold-casted concrete samples' (p.15); ref. 47: '...Using 2-in. or [50-mm] Cube Specimens'
